meta.title: ATELIER | Premium Burgers, Panini & Drinks
meta.description: ATELIER is a premium burger, panini, hot dog, dessert, and drinks concept.

hero.title: A focused atelier for burgers, panini, and drinks.
hero.body: ATELIER brings together generous comfort food, considered ingredients, and an all-day drinks rhythm in a clean, modern format.

concept.title: Built around everyday quality.
concept.body: The foundation is simple: a tight menu, strong core categories, and a brand system that can grow without becoming noisy.

points.title: Food with structure
points.body: Burgers, panini, hot dogs, starters, and desserts are organized as clear categories from day one.

points.title: Drinks as a full pillar
points.body: Refreshments, water, beers, spirits, and aperitif options are treated as part of the concept, not an afterthought.

points.title: Content first
points.body: Copy and menu data live outside the HTML so the website can evolve without layout rewrites.

featured.title: ATELIER signatures.
featured.body: A focused selection of strong products from the finalized ATELIER menu.
